owned_row_version.overflow: Hold for reconciliation; never wrap or reset.

owned_rows: The adapter uses the revenue-desk-report-v1: namespace in both existing unique identity fields. It writes only new scoped verification-attempt and immutable WorkDrive-draft rows; it does not select or modify legacy rows. report_delivery_v1 records reuse the same encrypted payload and unique identity/CAS for per-test initial delivery and confirmed resend; no legacy rows are rewritten.
state: Use existing encrypted ReportPayloadJson for canonical state, bounded to 9500 UTF-8 bytes, with mandatory identity, actual terminal period and status projections independently checked on readback. A verified draft stores its exact resource/version/hash receipt in existing encrypted ReportObjectKey. Verification attempts are explicitly not generated reports.
delivery_boundary: Generated drafts remain NotSent and owner review is a separate state. A separately protected, initially disabled report_delivery_v1 workflow may send the completed/fresh/validated summary once to the explicitly verified per-test Contact recipient under standing initial-delivery authority. Manual resend requires exact revision/recipient confirmation. Provider acceptance is not inbox receipt, read or follow-up. No live delivery binding is installed.
legacy_rows: Preserve every existing row and column. RD_REPORT_VERSION remains null for legacy rows; no default, backfill, reset, migration or deletion is proposed.
activation: Only the nullable RD_REPORT_VERSION column is an additive proposal. Existing-column entries record observed requirements, not requested additions. Fresh authorized Development identity/schema readback, exact type/encryption/unique constraints, conditional-update and ambiguous-write qualification, private destination binding and trusted factory composition remain prerequisites. No new table, queue, cron or environment toggle is proposed. This file authorizes no live schema or data write.
